title: EnrichedEvent
description: Schema for a fraud-enriched transaction event emitted by Flink after pattern detection. Extends TransactionEvent with risk metadata. This is the record written to Apache Iceberg.

transaction_id.description: Inherited from TransactionEvent. Iceberg primary key.

event_time.description: Inherited epoch ms. Iceberg partition key (HOUR granularity for transactions, DAY for fraud_alerts).

risk_score.description: Composite fraud risk score in [0, 1] computed by Flink. 0 = no risk, 1 = maximum risk. For LOCATION_JUMP, proportional to computed travel speed (km/h). For VELOCITY_BREACH, proportional to excess transaction count.

fraud_flags.description: List of fraud patterns triggered for this transaction. Empty array for legitimate transactions.

is_fraud.description: True if fraud_flags is non-empty. Denormalized for efficient Iceberg partition filtering.

processing_time_ms.description: Wall-clock milliseconds from Flink event ingestion to enriched record emission. Used to verify the 80ms p99 latency invariant.

flink_processing_timestamp.description: Unix epoch milliseconds at which Flink emitted this enriched record. Used as the dbt source loaded_at_field for freshness checks.
